item.description: ### Added - **New remote-ready session.** Gear menu → New Remote-Ready Session… starts an agent in a project folder inside tmux, so you can reach it from your iPhone later. - **Stats: hover a day, see a trend, share a card.** Hovering a heatmap day shows its turns per agent, a chart shows the trend over the chosen range, and Copy image / Share makes a card of your stats. - **Answer OpenCode's typed questions from your iPhone.** When OpenCode asks for a written answer, you can type it on the iPhone (needs the next iPhone app update). The setting is now called "Answer agents' questions from your iPhone" and stays as you had it.
